creator: Alexander Terp
description: Configured [[daemon]] blocks now attach on their own threads with a 1 s grace, so a slow one no longer holds the window closed. The daemon Muster finds for itself when no [[daemon]] is configured still attaches while the window opens, as before. Its first launch after an update can take 44 s while macOS scans the new binary.
title: The daemon Muster finds for itself attaches off the startup path too
